EDDI 6.7.1 is a **security and fix release on 6.7.0**. It closes **Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)** in every image EDDI ships, fixes a **chat-input expression injection** and three more security issues found in the pre-release reviews, makes the **Platform Operator** activatable again, and refreshes the **model catalog**.

- 🔒 **Java4Shell fixed.** All three base images run a patched JDK, and the interim `-XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics` flag stays on as a second line of defence.
- 🛡️ **Four security fixes i

- ✉️ **New channels and feedback.** An **email channel** (IMAP trigger mode and threaded conversation mode, with DKIM/DMARC checks), **conversation ratings**, and **alert rules** for bad ratings, failed turns and output matches.
Shared state, events and deployments across nodes, node identity with duplicate detection, a **signed control plane** (`eddi.cluster.signing.key`, HMAC-SHA256), fence-first leases that never lower the fence, lost-reply adoption, NATS TLS host-name verification and fail-loud read

- 📈 **Scale and overload.** Turns run on virtual threads behind an in-flight limit, EDDI scales out on **NATS JetStream**, database round trips per turn dropped from 16.7 to about 6.5, and overload is refused early with `503` instead of queueing without bound.
| 🗄️ **MongoDB user** | EDDI connects as `eddi_app` instead of root. Compose and Helm create the user on every start, so existing volumes migrate without a manual step. Kustomize users with their own `mongodb-secrets` need the patch in `docs/u

> **Read the Breaking Changes before upgrading.** Several defaults now fail closed. Some Keycloak realms, Helm releases with the in-chart MongoDB, and weak vault master keys will **stop a deployment from starting or make it answer 401/403** until you act. Full procedure: [`[docs/upgrading-from-6.4.md](https://claude.ai/epitaxy/docs/upgrading-from-6.4.md)`](docs/upgrading-from-6.4.md). For databases that came from EDDI 5: [`[docs/upgrading-from-5x.md](https://claude.ai/epitaxy/docs/upgrading-from-5x.md)`](do

The rest of the release is a correctness effort driven by a whole-repository code review and a full end-to-end run of 6.4.0 (342 REST operations, all 84 MCP tools, every group style). Many of the resulting fixes apply to code that shipped in 6.3.0 or earlier, including audit ledger verification, agent sync, scheduling on PostgreSQL and configuration deletes, so **upgrading is recommended independently of the new features**. Please review the Breaking Changes before upgrading.

### Fixed
- Ask AI on an error raised before any statement of an event ran (an event procedure whose parameters do not match the event: "Argument not optional") no longer just ends the program: it ends, then asks the AI about the procedure.
- Ask AI on an error brings the IDE window in front of the program's form windows and shows a dialog at once, so the request is never running unseen.

### Added
- New Project offers runnable Text Editor, Drawing and Serial presets.
- The `@` (Currency) type suffix on names and number literals.

### Changed
- Running programs draw faster on forms with many controls (the menu bar is no longer looked up per graphics operation), and loading many control-array elements in a loop no longer slows down quadratically.
- The designer finds, selects and outlines controls without scanning the whole form per control; commands no longer clone every control, re-render t

### Added
- Ask AI now lets you choose selected code, the current procedure or the whole code file, with optional instructions to make a minimal change, preserve the layout or explain the changes.
- Include a schematic of the current form from either the designer or its code window. Attach up to two PNG, JPEG or WebP reference images (5 MiB each), review their thumbnails and remove them before sending. Per-request choices keep the global AI preferences unchanged.
- A larger request field, side-by-side image
